# Dr. Ashfaq ul Hassan

Professor & Head, Clinical Anatomy and Histology, SKIMS, Srinagar.
16+ years teaching experience. USMLE, MRCS, PLAB, GMC UK and UAE Ministry of Health certified.
170+ publications and 40+ books authored across NEET-PG, NEET-SS, USMLE, MRCS, PLAB, FMGE and Arab Board preparation.
